# FoliageLayer

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("FoliageLayer")`

Covers terrain with foliage such as grass, flowers, stones and bushes. Its `FoliageMesh` children set what grows, and its properties set where: by the ground's material, slope and height, and never under a roof.

It is visual only. Nothing collides with it, raycasts pass through it, and it is not replicated; every machine generates the same field from the same terrain and `Seed`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Clumping` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much the foliage gathers into patches, from 0 (even cover) to 1 (tufts with bare ground between them). |
| `Density` | `number` | `2` | read/write | The number of instances per square meter of ground where every rule allows growth. The material's multiplier, the painted mask and the `[render] foliage_density` setting scale it. |
| `DrawDistance` | `number` | `120` | read/write | The distance from the camera, in meters, within which the layer is drawn. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the layer grows. When it is off, nothing is placed or drawn. |
| `FadeDistance` | `number` | `20` | read/write | The distance, in meters, before `DrawDistance` over which the foliage thins out, so that the edge of the field is not a visible line. |
| `HeightMax` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | The highest height the layer grows at, in meters in world space. Use it for a tree line. |
| `HeightMin` | `number` | `-10000` | read/write | The lowest height the layer grows at, in meters in world space. |
| `MinSpacing` | `number` | `0.25` | read/write | The smallest distance between two instances, in meters. |
| `ReceivesDecals` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a `Decal` also marks the foliage. When it is on, a decal on the ground also appears on the foliage standing in it, whichever way each blade faces. When it is off, decals skip the foliage, as they skip a part with `BasePart.ReceivesDecals` off. |
| `Seed` | `number` | `0` | read/write | A number that selects one of the possible arrangements the rules allow. The same seed gives the same field on every machine. |
| `SlopeMax` | `number` | `35` | read/write | The steepest ground the layer grows on, in degrees from level. |
| `SlopeMin` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The flattest ground the layer grows on, in degrees from level. |

## Methods

### `GetMaterials(): { { Material: number, Density: number } }`

Returns the terrain materials the layer grows on, each with a multiplier on `Density`. Material `n` is the terrain's layer `n` (see `Terrain:GetLayers`). An empty list means every material, at a multiplier of 1.

### `SetMaterials(materials: { { read Material: number, read Density: number? } })`

Sets the terrain materials the layer grows on, in the form that `GetMaterials` returns: up to 32, with `Density` defaulting to 1. An empty list grows on every material. The list is saved with the scene.
